info.title: eitheror casino partner API
info.description:
Read-only access to one casino brand's players, their play and money movements, the games
catalogue, and precomputed game statistics. Every endpoint is a `GET`.

## Authentication

Request an access token with the OAuth 2.0 client-credentials grant, using the client id and
secret you were issued, then send it on every call as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

```
curl -s https://auth.pre.eitheror.io/realms/eitheror/protocol/openid-connect/token \
  -d grant_type=client_credentials -d client_id=<id> -d client_secret=<secret>
```

Tokens last 5 minutes. Fetch a new one when it expires or when a call answers `401` with
`jwt_expired`; there is no refresh token. `/v1/openapi.json` needs no token.

## Scope

A credential belongs to exactly one brand, and every response is limited to that brand. A
record of another brand answers `404`, exactly as a record that does not exist. To read
several brands, use one credential per brand.

Identifying player fields (name, email, date of birth, phone, address) are returned only where
your agreement covers them. A field you are not entitled to is absent from the response, never
`null`.

## Formats

- Money is an exact decimal string in major units with two decimal places (`"12.50"`), always
  alongside a `currency` (ISO 4217). Never parse it as a float.
- Timestamps are ISO 8601 with an explicit offset.
- Objects carry only the fields documented here. Optional fields are omitted when unknown.

## Paging

Collections return `{ "data": [...], "page": { "limit", "offset", "total", "hasMore" } }`,
ordered oldest first. Page with `limit` (1–100, default 100) and `offset`; keep going while
`hasMore` is true. The newest records are on the last page, at `offset = total - limit`.

## Quotas

Each credential has an agreed number of requests per minute (600 unless agreed otherwise).
Over it, calls answer `429` with a `Retry-After` header in seconds; wait that long and retry.

## Errors

Every error is JSON, `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "..." }`. Branch on `error`, not on
`message`.

| Status | Codes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `invalid_request`, `limit_exceeded`, `scope_invalid` | A parameter or identifier is malformed or out of range |
| 401 | `jwt_missing`, `jwt_invalid`, `jwt_expired`, `jwt_issuer_mismatch`, `jwt_verification_failed` | No usable token: fetch a new one |
| 401 | `actor_type_invalid`, `scope_missing`, `scope_invalid` | The credential itself is misconfigured: contact us, a new token will not help |
| 403 | `grant_absent`, `grant_disabled`, `scope_mismatch` | The credential is valid but has no access to this brand: contact us |
| 404 | `not_found` | No such record in your brand |
| 410 | `snapshot_expired` | The ranking snapshot you named has been retired: start again from page 1 without `snapshot` |
| 429 | `quota_exceeded` | Over your per-minute quota: wait `Retry-After` seconds |
| 503 | `unavailable` | Temporary: retry with backoff |

## Game statistics

Statistics are recomputed every hour, a few minutes past the hour, over rolling windows of the
last 1, 7 and 30 days ending at `computedAt`. They are not live: expect figures up to an hour
old. Cancelled rounds are excluded. Rounds, sessions and unique players include free-spins
play; stake, win and GGR (stake minus win) are real money only, one entry per currency. Each
window is a total, not a time series: to chart a trend, store each day's figures yourself.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: ISO 4217 code. Required when `sort` is `stake` or `ggr`; ignored otherwise.

200.description: Games in descending order of the chosen statistic. Games with no activity in the window are absent.

computedAt.description: When the figures were computed. Absent when never computed for this brand.

get.summary: One player's figures for the last 1, 7 and 30 days
get.description: From the current snapshot. A player of your brand with no activity reports zeros. Status is not repeated here; read it from the player record.

get.summary: Players of the brand ranked by one figure in one window
get.description: Rankings are recomputed every hour and published as snapshots. The first page names its snapshot; pass `snapshot` on every later page to read one fixed ranking start to finish. A snapshot stays readable for at least 30 minutes after a newer one replaces it; after that the request is refused with 410 `snapshot_expired` and you start again from page 1 without `snapshot`. `status` is the player's status when the snapshot was computed. The `status` filter is for reporting: a player who self-excludes after the snapshot keeps their old status until the next one, so check the player record before contacting anyone.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Ranked descending. `deposits` ranks by deposited amount.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Required when `sort` is `stake`, `ggr` or `deposits`; ignored otherwise. Only players with figures in this currency are ranked.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma-separated statuses to include, e.g. `ACTIVE,SUSPENDED`. Omit for every status. Ranks are unchanged by the filter, so they can have gaps.

parameters.name: snapshot
parameters.description: The snapshot id from the first page. Omit for the current snapshot.

200.description: A page of the ranking. Before the first computation for the brand, an empty page with no `snapshot`.

bearerAuth.description: Access token from the client-credentials grant; see Authentication above.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, expired or untrusted credential

Forbidden.description: Grant absent or disabled, or credential scope does not match the grant's brand

NotFound.description: No such record in the partner's brand

Unavailable.description: The platform store is unreachable or exceeded the request budget

SnapshotExpired.description: The named snapshot has been retired; restart from page 1 without `snapshot`

Money.description: Exact decimal in major units, two decimal places, as a string.

email.description: Identifying. Present only where the grant entitles it.

paymentRef.description: Originating cashier payment id. Deposits only.

tags.description: Lower-cased union of bonusTypes, features and themes.

rounds.description: Non-cancelled rounds created in the window, free-spins rounds included.

amounts.description: Real-money figures only; free-spins rounds and bonus-wallet play excluded. One entry per currency.

computedAt.description: Absent when statistics have never been computed for this game.
